name: com.danielnoam.systems
description:
Gameplay systems, shaders and effects: audio library and tracks, first person controller, object pooling, menu system, scheduling, grid, radar, radial menu, SDF shapes, springs, damage numbers, controller rumble, and a fullscreen VFX and transition stack.

The largest and most opinionated package of the suite, and the only one that pulls in URP, Timeline and VFX Graph.

Requires PrimeTween, which is a paid asset and cannot be resolved from a registry — install it into the project separately before adding this package.

samples.description: A scene-ready component demonstrating the attributes, custom fields and selectors across the suite.
